context: Accepted without fix during the fix review of the discovery/queue follow-ups (merged as db9d0be). Evidence: review-r2/adjudication.md.
description: Discovery treats a generation-0 request as stale when the PR has a recorded non-proof review and a trusted, unexpired state artifact exists. If BenchBox rolls back to an engine version that does not read state generations, its requests carry generation 0 and can be staled even though they are current. Separately, queue rows created before the proof-column migration default to proof = 0; harmless today because no installed database exists, but it matters if a database is created before that migration ships.
